theorem: Every primitive radial one-step edge is contained in exactly two elementary triangles, hence every A1 endpoint orientation has exactly two legitimate pre-circle segment lifts and there are exactly twelve lifted states in the full D6 family.
D6_covariance: rotate/reflection acts simultaneously on the radial edge and incident triangle; the twelve-state family is closed
reversal: holding e fixed and exchanging its two incident side triangles reverses the local sweep orientation; together with global D6 reversal this interchanges the two six-state oriented families
ambiguity_policy: both side lifts survive; neither is selected as canonical
AQ_seed_relation: AR uses 2 cells incident to the segment EDGE, not AQ's 6 cells incident only to the free endpoint; the reduction is segment-incidence information, not circle matching
